[agent] Janitor: the hourly issue and discussion janitor rewrites this log each run. It shows the last run, the actions it took with a reason for each, a rolling list of recent actions, deferred candidates, and anything that needs a human. The routine writes it to the `janitor/ledger` branch, and a workflow on that branch applies it here.

## Last run
2026-10-06 13:26Z on origin/main `9c43dfc9`. 292 open issues and the PRs merged since the last run were reviewed. Since `6811b4e7`, 24 PRs merged (2026-10-05 13:39–18:18Z), and most of the issues they fix auto-closed. No PRs merged on 2026-10-06.

## This run
- **Issues closed (3):** #417 (PR #598), #585 (PR #597) and #264 (PR #646). The first two were "Fixes #A and #B" cases where only #A auto-closed. #264 was fixed by the Gradle PR's agent-mode jar swap, which covers every `pkg:maven` record. Each was verified on origin/main (code plus a regression test).
- **Claims released (2):** #742 and #650 (`Claim-ID: 2026-10-04T03:20:54Z-020a8f`). #743 merged with only the hosted slice and #766 with only the requirements.txt slice. There is no PR for the vendored half and no claimer activity for more than 48h. Both issues stay open.
- **Labels fixed:** removed `agent:claimed` from #417 and from 33 closed issues: #347, #348, #349, #362, #372, #395, #396, #428, #429, #432, #461, #487, #511, #533, #546, #551, #590, #627, #632, #645, #652, #709, #725, #728, #736, #756, #772, #781, #796, #798, #804, #840 and #847. Every bughunt issue has its `pm:*` label.
- **Discussion ops:** drift comments on Gradle ledger #319, which hasn't been updated since 2026-10-03. Its matrix still lists #347, #348, #349, #395, #396, #428, #429, #461, #487, #511, #533 and #551 as `fail`, and all of them were closed by #646. Single-issue drift comments went to #307 (#372, fixed by #820), #316 (#709, fixed by #712), #320 (#627, fixed by #802) and #302 (#432, fixed by #813). #303, #304, #305, #310 and #313 already note their fixes in the prose, so they were skipped. #575 has no drift.
- **Checked and kept open:** #706 and #823, where PRs #865 and #850 were explicit partial slices ("issue stays open"), and #424 (PR #456 says "not fixed here"). The 2026-10-06 issues #860–#939 aren't exact duplicates. The BOM cluster #903, #904 and #905 is deliberately grouped (one symptom per lane plus the arch-audit root). #921, #935, #938 and #939 are `file:`/registry copies in different PMs or with different triggers. #880 and #881 are hosted vs vendored. #910 and #926 are different commands.
